adaptation: CommonJS modules converted to ESM with named exports.
readability() and the WCAG threshold constants were added so the contrast verdict lives in one place instead of being recomputed by each caller.
ramp() was added: the deterministic lightness ramp used by the incubator room now has a single home instead of living in the room handler.
buildSwatch() was added on top of the donor canvas helpers so a palette becomes an image deterministically.
Only color.js and png.js were copied: the donor theme directory also contains contract/builder/asset-factory/designer/orchestrator modules, which belong to later waves.
knownDifferences: No theme contract, validator, builder, asset factory or preview: those are wave 2.
Nothing is applied to the Alien Web UI; this module produces colours and images only.
No theme registry, lifecycle or recovery: the donor's orchestration layer is out of scope.

vectors: hex / rgb() / rgba() / percentage grammar including transparent and rejection cases
channel clamping, hex round-trip, alpha compositing
WCAG contrast ratio (21:1 extremes) and readability levels
PNG encode -> independent decode round-trip for RGB and RGBA
PNG header reading and rejection of non-PNG input
swatch determinism, column layout and alpha preservation
